To increase the resolution in ISAR imaging, we propose the 2-Dimensional- Reweighted Trace Minimization (2D-RWTM) method to retrieve frequencies of sparse scattering points in both range and cross-range directions
Using computer simulations, the proposed 2D-RWTM is compared to the Atomic Norm Minimization (ANM) in terms of the Mean Squared Errors (MSE)
